title: DocNode
description: One entry in the doc graph. Frozen at Phase 1 (APPROVAL GATE 1) — see docs/annotation-tags.md for the annotation vocabulary this is extracted from.

filePath.description: Path to the source file, relative to the target repo root.

contentHash.description: Hash (e.g. sha256) of the exact source range this node was derived from. Mismatch on re-scan means the node is stale.

agentContract.description: Structured facet for agents (Section 2.1 of docgen-plugin-plan.md).

sideEffects.description: ['none'] when the @contract side-effects clause is explicitly 'none'.

errorModes.description: One entry per @contract `throws:` clause. Used by Phase 8's error<->troubleshooting cross-check.

dependencies.description: nodeIds this entity calls/imports/depends on. Normally derived from AST edges; @contract's optional `deps:` clause overrides/augments this for dependencies invisible to static analysis.

humanNarrative.description: Prose facet for humans (Section 2.1 of docgen-plugin-plan.md).

confidence.description: Per-field confidence map, dot-path keyed into agentContract/humanNarrative. Deliberately per-field rather than a single node-level value, because Phase 8 requires tagging 'every generated field' individually (docgen-plugin-plan.md Section 2.4) -- e.g. a mechanically-extracted signature and an LLM-inferred rationale on the same node can carry different confidence.

revisionHistory.description: Per-node revision log, independent of the document-level Revision History table (Phase 3).

tags.description: Flat key:value tag list, e.g. requirement:REQ-042, audience:business, audience:agent-only. Rollup filters (SRS/PRD/business guide/etc.) select nodes by scanning this array.
